ann: Improve search quality and recall rates for billion-scale vector similarity search without significantly increasing memory usage or query latency.
cli: Improve type safety and validation by adding comprehensive support for custom type definitions, nested validation rules, and runtime schema enforcement across complex command hierarchies.
columnar: Improve query execution performance and optimization capabilities for complex analytical workloads across distributed columnar data.
compiler: Numba needs improved compilation times and reduced memory overhead for large-scale numerical applications and complex nested function calls.
crypto: The project needs better post-quantum cryptography support and algorithms to prepare for quantum-resistant encryption requirements.
cv: The library needs better support for efficient inference optimization, model quantization, and deployment to resource-constrained edge devices.
db: Improve support for distributed query execution and horizontal scaling across multiple nodes to handle larger-than-memory datasets efficiently.
diffusion: The project needs better inference performance optimization and memory efficiency for running large diffusion models on resource-constrained devices.
encryption: Improve interoperability and usability across diverse platforms by developing standardized integration plugins for common applications and workflows.
graph: The project needs better scalability and memory efficiency for training Graph Neural Networks on very large graphs with billions of nodes and edges.
http: Requests needs to support HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 protocols for modern web communication requirements.
linter: Improve cross-file and dependency analysis capabilities to detect complex issues spanning multiple modules, classes, and function calls.
llminfer: Improve multi-GPU distributed inference performance and scaling to efficiently utilize multiple accelerators for larger models and higher throughput workloads.
numerics: Improve performance and memory efficiency of numerical algorithms through better optimization, vectorization, and parallelization across diverse hardware architectures.
peft: Improve support for seamlessly combining multiple PEFT methods on the same model and enable automatic hyperparameter tuning for different adapter configurations.
rag: Improve memory efficiency and scalability of dense vector indexing and retrieval for extremely large corpora to enable sub-millisecond query latency with minimal storage overhead.
rl: The project needs better support for distributed training across multiple machines and GPUs to handle large-scale reinforcement learning experiments more efficiently.
speech: The project needs improved inference latency and reduced memory consumption to enable real-time transcription on resource-constrained devices.
storage: RocksDB needs improved cross-platform portability and reduced compilation complexity to simplify deployment across diverse hardware and operating system environments.
systems: Improve cluster scaling and multi-node distributed deployment capabilities to handle larger datasets and higher throughput across multiple instances.
thin-gnn: The project needs better support for heterogeneous graph types and diverse node/edge feature representations beyond current capabilities.
thin-kv: Improve distributed transaction consistency guarantees and conflict resolution to handle complex multi-shard transactional workloads more robustly.
thin-lang: The project needs robust standard library functions and built-in implementations to make the language practical for real-world use.
vectordb: Improve query latency and throughput for large-scale distributed deployments with enhanced sharding strategies and cross-shard query optimization.
webdev: Flask needs built-in support for async/await request handlers and middleware to fully leverage modern Python async capabilities beyond current limited ASGI support.
